name: palung-io
description: PALUNG.IO - Platform Game Trivia Kelangkaan Multiplayer Terinspirasi Krillion.io

scripts.mobile:build: node scripts/build-mobile-assets.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:build: if exist public\PALUNG-IO.apk del /F /Q public\PALUNG-IO.apk && node scripts/build-mobile-assets.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\PALUNG-IO.apk && copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\public\PALUNG-IO.apk
